summary: Garpax Records was an American record label founded by Gary S. Paxton that operated from 1962 to 1965. The label is notable for first issuing "Monster Mash" by Bobby "Boris" Pickett in 1962. It was distributed by London Records.
one_line: Garpax Records was a short-lived American record label (1962–1965) founded by Gary S. Paxton that first released "Monster Mash."
key_facts: Garpax Records was an American record label.
Garpax Records was established by Gary S. Paxton.
Garpax Records first issued the song "Monster Mash" by Bobby "Boris" Pickett in 1962.
Garpax Records was distributed by London Records.
The Garpax Records label lasted from 1962 to 1965.
